svg.text: Prototype rigs after 20 s in a 7.6 m/s beam wind (16 substeps). Grey outline: initial shape.
Blue: coarse cloth triangles. Black: Cosserat spars and rigid spar links. Orange: running lines (one constraint through their blocks). Dashed grey: standing rigging. Squares: hull pins.
H-boat 6x6, side view (x east, z up)
H-boat 6x6, from astern (y port, z up)
H-boat 6x6, plan view (x east, y port), wind from -y side
Suomen Joutsen stand-in: 30 sails of 6x6, 192 Cosserat yard and topmast segments, 216 lines, side view
